analyst.summary: Abbott India: high-quality, debt-free domestic branded-formulations business with FY26 sales/PAT up 8.1%/9.7% YoY and industry-best ~28% margins, but growth is decelerating below its own trailing CAGR while trading at a rich 38.8x P/E / 12.6x P/B; Q1 FY27 results not yet out as of this check.
